picks.file: Conil ; Xeres de la Frontera - btv1b53178983g (1 of 2).jpg
picks.what: Engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 2
picks.who: Georg Braun and Frans Hogenberg, after Joris Hoefnagel
picks.why: colored single-sheet copy (no gutter); walled town with its towers and the Alcázar on the skyline; trimmed to the lower view, Conil above cut away

gaps: P0, P2, P3, P4, P5: no candidates; P6: only balcony shots of modern apartment blocks, skipped
notes: #4 is the BnF copy of the 1575 plate (Commons date 1645 is that edition). #1–#3 are bound atlases with the gutter through the view, #5 is the text verso, #6 is uncolored. The four 2024 photos (#7–#10) from a flat on the Plaza de las Marinas show no recognizable part of the city.
